subject: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv
body:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@lexiv.io>, S.Rao <sanjay.rao@lexiv.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Two quick goals from my side: confirm the procurement route for the pilot, and lock in the billing start gate so your finance team knows when invoicing will begin.

High-level recap / asks:
- Procurement route: PO (net terms) vs company card vs marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP) — which does Lexiv prefer for a short pilot?
- Paperwork: you flagged a need for an SOW + SIG/Attestation for our security posture. I'm attaching the current SOW draft and the brief MATP (security) answers for your team to share with procurement.
- Trial success criteria (proposed): usage window of 30 days with sustained inference throughput hitting >=50k tokens/day for 20/30 days OR achievement of the two product KPIs you mentioned (entity-extraction recall >= 92% on the sample set; end-to-end job time < 4s median).
- Billing start: propose billing begins on the first calendar day after the trial gates are satisfied (not earlier than the agreed-upon pilot start date). If procurement requires invoicing before the gate, we can agree on a demo invoice hold and credit once gates are met.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm procurement contact and preferred payment method by EOD Wed 9/29.
2) Lexiv to confirm which success metric triggers fair acceptance (tokens threshold vs KPI).
3) I will update SOW with the chosen billing trigger and PO/marketplace language and send for signature.

Attachments: Lexiv_MATP_ans.pdf (security Q&A), REDWOOD-SOW-draft-v1.docx (SOW draft).

Thanks — Michael

--
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

---

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@lexiv.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: S.Rao <sanjay.rao@lexiv.io>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv

Thanks Michael — great demo. Quick answers from our side:
- Procurement: Preference is PO (central procurement). We can do a company card for initial POC expenses but centralized procurement prefers POs so the pilot can be tracked against existing commitments.
- Marketplace: We are interested in marketplace listing (GCP) long term, but for now procurement requires an SOW/contract to start the pilot. Marketplace would be for production rollouts.
- Security: SOC2 + the MATP answers you shared look good. Our security lead will validate and may ask for one small clarification on key rotation; I will forward the contact.
- Trial metrics: we like the KPIs you proposed; to be concrete, Lexiv will treat the trial as successful if both entity-extraction recall >= 92% AND median latency < 4s over a 14-day evaluation window within the pilot.

We will provide the procurement contact and a PO template by EOD Thu 9/30.

-Anita

--
Anita Shah
Head of Product, Lexiv Analytics
anita.shah@lexiv.io | (212) 555-3321

---

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@lexiv.io>, S.Rao <sanjay.rao@lexiv.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv

Appreciate the quick response and the concrete acceptance criteria, Anita. Two small clarifications from our side: 
1) Billing start language options:
   - Option A (usage gate): Billing begins the day after you hit the tokens/KPI gate (we issue invoice monthly thereafter).
   - Option B (contractual start): Billing begins on an agreed calendar date regardless of gate; if gate isn’t met we credit or pause billing per SOW.
Please indicate which you prefer.

2) PO specifics: if procurement uses PO, do you need invoices on Net30 to be routed to a specific AP mailbox? If you could share the AP contact and any PO-number formatting requirements that will avoid delays.

I'll cue our legal ops to prep both Option A and Option B billing clauses so we can slot whichever you pick into the SOW. Also copying Grace who will own the onboarding/activation timeline.

Best,
Michael

--

From: S.Rao <sanjay.rao@lexiv.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Shah <anita.shah@lexiv.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv

Michael — thanks. Procurement contact below:
- AP: Priya Menon <priya.menon@lexiv.io>; PO template attached (we will map PO # to opportunity id).

Lexiv preference: Option A (billing tied to gates) but procurement wants the SOW in place before they will issue a PO. They can issue a PO with the agreed gate language and Net30 terms. We are also exploring marketplace for future scale, but please keep SOW explicit that marketplace is not the billing route for this pilot.

On invoices: monthly invoices to AP with PO# in header is fine.

Thanks — Sanjay

--
Sanjay Rao
VP Engineering, Lexiv Analytics
sanjay.rao@lexiv.io

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv

Quick operational note: when we put Option A in the SOW we should define the mechanics so AP doesn't get stuck: 
- Measurement: tokens/day computed from aggregated inference logs (UTC) with a 24-hr rolling average; threshold = 50,000 tokens/day sustained for 20 of 30 calendar days.
- Validation: Redwood will publish the token report to a shared Drive link and CC Lexiv AP and product owner; Lexiv will have 3 business days to dispute measurements before invoicing.
- Credit flow: if invoice issued early we will issue a credit if gate not met during the retro window.

Also suggest a pilot kickoff date of Mon 10/05 to allow our infra team two weeks to configure dedicated routing and KMS entries if they want an isolated dataset. That gives procurement the SOW week of 9/28 to approve and issue PO by 10/04.

Connor

--
Connor O'Brien
Technical PM, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@lexiv.io>, S.Rao <sanjay.rao@lexiv.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement readiness & billing start conditions for Lexiv

Great — thanks everyone. Summary and mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Lexiv will issue PO to Priya Menon (priya.menon@lexiv.io) using the SOW we will circulate.
2) Redwood to update SOW with Option A billing gate language (tokens/KPI) + measurement & dispute window per Connor's notes.
3) Security: Lexiv security will validate MATP answers; Michael to loop in Redwood security if any follow-ups.
4) Pilot kickoff target: Mon 10/05/2026 (contingent on PO delivery by 10/04).
5) Billing start: the day after the gate is met (Option A). Monthly invoices to Priya Menon / AP with PO# on header; Net30.

I'll circulate REDWOOD-SOW-draft-v1.docx updated with the above changes this afternoon and include the HubSpot deal record and DocuSign link once ready. Please reply-all with any objections; otherwise we'll assume this MAP and move forward.

Thanks — Michael

Attachments referenced: REDWOOD-SOW-draft-v1.docx, Lexiv_MATP_ans.pdf
